segments.name: Branded Products
products: corporate awards, incentives and recognition programs
segments.description: Produces and sells customized merchandising solutions, promotional products and branded uniform programs to customers across many industries.
segments.evidence: Superior's Branded Products segment, primarily through its signature marketing brands BAMKO® and HPI®, produces and sells customized merchandising solutions, promotional products and branded uniform programs.

segments.name: Healthcare Apparel
segments.description: Manufactures and sells healthcare apparel such as scrubs, lab coats, protective apparel and patient apparel to laundries, dealers, distributors, retailers and consumers.
segments.evidence: Superior's Healthcare Apparel segment, primarily through its portfolio of brands Wink® and Fashion Seal Healthcare®, its trade name CID Resources and its license of Carhartt Medical, manufactures (through third parties or in its own facilities) and sells a wide range of healthcare apparel, such as scrubs, lab coats, protective apparel and patient apparel.

segments.name: Contact Centers
products: email, text, chat and social media support
segments.description: Provides outsourced, nearshore and onshore business process outsourcing and contact and call-center support services to North American customers.
segments.evidence: In our Contact Centers segment (also known as The Office Gurus), which operates in El Salvador, Belize, Dominican Republic, the United States and Jamaica until its closure on June 15, 2025, we provide outsourced, nearshore and onshore business process outsourcing, contact and call-center support services to North American customers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Superior for customized promotional products and branded uniforms, healthcare apparel, and outsourced contact-center support services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company produces and manufactures (through third parties or in its own facilities) and sells a wide range of promotional products and branded uniforms in its Branded Products segment and healthcare apparel and accessories in its Healthcare Apparel segment.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company closed its Jamaica contact center operations within the Contact Centers segment.
